entities.summary: Samuel George Coppersmith is an American attorney and former politician who served as the U.S. representative for Arizona's 1st congressional district from 1993 to 1995. He is a member of the Democratic Party. Sam Coppersmith was a legal figures from Johnstown (b. 1955-05-22, Johnstown). A moderately significant entity in the historical record.
